acquisition_method: DDA MS analysis was performed for downstream spectral library generation for downstream DIA MS
alkylation_concentration: Samples were then incubated with 8 M urea buffer containing 50 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min in the dark.
alkylation_reagent: Samples were then incubated with 8 M urea buffer containing 50 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min in the dark.
collision_energy: For DDA analysis of SAX-fractionated samples, peptides from each fraction (n of fractions: 6) were eluted in a 90 min gradient (flow: 300 nL/min, mobile phase A: 0.1% formic acid in H2O, mobile phase B: 99.9% acetonitrile and 0.1% formic acid). The 15 most abundant peaks from the MS scan (resolution: 70,000 at 200 m/z) were selected and fragmented by higher energy induced collision dissociation (HCD, collision energy: 30).
fractionation_method: For DDA MS analysis (sample set 1), a total of 50 μg of the protein content was digested for each sample followed by strong anion-exchange fractionation following previously described protocols.
fragmentation_method: For DDA analysis of SAX-fractionated samples, peptides from each fraction (n of fractions: 6) were eluted in a 90 min gradient (flow: 300 nL/min, mobile phase A: 0.1% formic acid in H2O, mobile phase B: 99.9% acetonitrile and 0.1% formic acid). The 15 most abundant peaks from the MS scan (resolution: 70,000 at 200 m/z) were selected and fragmented by higher energy induced collision dissociation (HCD, collision energy: 30).

instrument.evidence: Global proteome DDA MS analysis was performed on a Q-Exactive Plus (Thermo Fisher) mass spectrometer (sample set 1).

ionization_type: inferred: ESI is commonly used in LC-MS/MS
labeling: DDA-derived RAW files were analyzed using MaxQuant (v1.6.0.16). MS spectra were searched using the Andromeda built-in search engine against the Uniprot-Swissprot human proteome database (version download 2017.06.12). Label-free quantification (LFQ) and match between run options were enabled.
mass_analyzer: inferred: Q-Exactive Plus has an Orbitrap mass analyzer

ptm.evidence: Fixed modifications: carbamidomethylation of Cys residues. Variable modifications: acetylation of the N-terminal residue, oxidation of Met residues.
